headline: Evaluate open-weight extraction, trial local coding agents, and restrict third-party wrappers

calls.title: Evaluate Patram 1.5 for multilingual document extraction
calls.text: Test Patram 1.5 on 30 multilingual, low-quality fund reports to compare field extraction accuracy and abstention rates against our current pipeline. The open-weight vision-language model can improve multilingual document extraction and PDF parsing for financial clients.

calls.title: Trial local Sarvam coding agents for data pipelines
calls.text: Test Sarvam-backed coding agents on a sample internal Python data pipeline script, measuring task completion time while ensuring zero external data leakage. Locally hosted agents with data residency comply with strict data rules.

calls.title: Prohibit unverified wrappers and foreign APIs for clients
calls.text: Strictly avoid unverified third-party wrappers and foreign APIs when processing confidential financial documents. Data leaks and unauthorized access at AI startups highlight the risk of prompt logging and retained user data.
